description: Long/short equity strategy using analyst signals. Signals: (1) Recommendations impulse W(a,s,t)=R(a,s,t)-R(a,s,tp) (2) Estimates vs prior/consensus. Processing: mean across analysts -> EWMA(halflife) -> x-sec z-score: (W-mu)/sigma. Portfolio: long top z-scores, short bottom z-scores. Constraints: max trade size as %ADV, single name weight limits.
status: FactSet analyst data. X-sec normalization ensures signal comparability. Sharpe 1.2-1.3. Metrics: EPS, EBITDA, FCF (where available), DPS, NDT (inverted - higher debt = worse). Portfolio constraints: trade size <= 5% ADV, single name weight limits.
